findings.title: Unescaping sanitized output can hide forbidden tags
findings.body: The sanitizer escapes disallowed markup as HTML entities, but this unescapes every entity in the sanitized result before comparing it with the original. For example, a forbidden tag such as `` can be escaped by the policy and then restored to the original text, making the comparison report no violation. This lets unsafe translated HTML pass the verifier, defeating the security check.

findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP instruction is in Italian
findings.body: This changed message says “Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:” (Italian), while the rest of this file is Lithuanian. Lithuanian users configuring TOTP will see an unrelated-language instruction; please use a Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: Lithuanian login instruction is in Italian
findings.body: This changed message says “Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:” (Italian), while the rest of this file is Lithuanian. Users configuring TOTP on the login flow will see an unrelated-language instruction; please use a Lithuanian translation.
